rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: At the AICC briefing of 19 October 2022 the Central Election Authority chairman repeats the tally and declares Mallikarjun Kharge elected as President of Indian National Congress.

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: Answering questions (Hindi), Shri Mistry says the programme would be settled with the President-elect and he hoped it would be like the one held for 'राहुल जी' (Rahul ji; the answer prints no surname), and that the certificate would be given to him formally, at a meeting, after his programmes.
